doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Defining swing
summary: He declines to define swing and says you point at examples.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Okay. Most people say no and then they’ll try. But as you said, go listen to Count Basie.
You see what you do is you point. Point at examples. And point when it’s not happening. And then somebody with big ears could begin to say aha, I get it.
